examples.english: And after they went inside they sat down.

examples.english: And the sons of Jacob were twelve.

examples.coptic: ⲟⲩⲟϩ **ⲉⲧ**ⲁⲫⲛⲁⲩ ⲛⲁϫⲡⲋ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲁ ⲟⲩⲭⲁⲕⲓ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ϣⲁⲫⲛⲁⲩ ⲛⲁϫⲡⲑ .
**ⲛⲧⲉⲣⲉ**ⲗⲱⲧ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲁϥϣⲁϫⲉ ⲙⲛⲛⲉϥϣⲙⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲧⲁⲩϫⲓ ⲛⲛⲉϥϣⲉⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲁⲩ ϫⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲧⲏⲩⲧⲛ ⲛⲧⲉⲧⲛⲉⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲙⲡⲉⲓⲙⲁ ϫⲉⲡϫⲟⲉⲓⲥ ⲛⲁⲧⲁⲕⲉⲧⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲁϥⲣⲧϩⲉ ⲛⲛⲉⲧⲥⲱⲃⲉ ⲙⲡⲙⲧⲟ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲛⲉϥϣⲙⲟⲩⲓ
examples.english: And Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law who had married his daughters, and said, Rise up, and depart out of this place, for the Lord is about to destroy the city; but he seemed to be speaking absurdly before his sons-in-law.
When the young man heard this, he was frightened.
examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 2

examples.english: O Lord, attend to my prayer: hearken to my supplication in thy truth; hear me in thy righteousness.
